record.reason: 100-LongBench proposes a length-controllable benchmark/metric that separates base model ability from long-context ability. It evaluates long-context enhancement methods, including memory-oriented work, but contributes evaluation rather than an inference optimization; useful as a measurement source, not direct method.
record.title: 100-LongBench: Are de facto Long-Context Benchmarks Literally Evaluating Long-Context Ability?
